summary: Answer scoped Claude MCP initialization while daemon incarnation discovery or mailbox binding is unavailable; keep initialization publication and EOF responsive.

replay.detail: No graph replay or historical mail replay. Existing uncertain handoff and receipt rules remain intact.

schema.detail: No table, column or schema-version change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or rules-version change. Fresh unallocated startup requests may wait for nonterminal hook/runtime ordering; this grants no ownership, read or receipt admission. Bound, ended and foreign incarnations remain fenced.

compatibility.detail: Push Claude MCP responds locally before ownership is available and only begins subscriptions after current binding. Its acknowledged publication retains the initialization-only diagnostic introduced by #1859, never provider ready/idle/working. A resumed channel with a saved/live incarnation mismatch is rejected before binding instead of reaching a later fence. Non-push Claude MCP also skips the synchronous daemon-incarnation wait; its existing filesystem protocol and owned readiness writer remain unchanged. Current replay capability and scope validation remain intact.

downtime.detail: No daemon downtime or database migration is required.

manual.detail: No new manual steps or native terminal input.

recovery.detail: A daemon outage can recover attachment in the same initialized MCP child. A child already closed by Claude is still recreated through existing bounded seat-restart recovery; no generic stale-capability retry is added.
